entities.summary: Erasmus Hospital is a teaching hospital in the municipality of Anderlecht, Brussels, Belgium. It is a research hospital associated with the Université libre de Bruxelles (ULB), and was opened in 1977. It has 1,048 beds and 4,000 employees, treating between 25,000 and 30,000 inpatients and between 350,000 and 400,000 outpatients each year. Erasmus Hospital is a hospital in Europe, established in 1968. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
